name: t109_guard_p1d
headline: AI Detected
windows: Whichever protective part showed up, try talking to it in the same Nurturer voice you meant for your little one.
A harder voice can seem more fitting for something that’s been in your way.
I’d still keep it the same. If that voice isn’t there in you yet, borrow it from someone who’s been safe for you.
At some point you can ask that part, “What are you afraid would happen if you stepped back?” Usually your little one only comes forward after that part feels heard.
